entities.name: Onakke
entities.description: Fallen civilization of Shandalar ogres, masters of dark arts and artifice.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: Demon who sent Liliana Vess to retrieve the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker sent to retrieve the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Artifact hidden in the Catacombs of the Onakke, binding angry Onakke spirits.

entities.name: Kurkesh
entities.description: Creator of the veil, a vengeful spirit.

entities.name: Catacombs of the Onakke
entities.description: Where the Chain Veil is hidden.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which dormant Onakke reawakened.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Its Omenpaths carried magic from Ravnica to Shandalar.

entities.name: Ursoth
entities.description: Monstrous creature hunted by Garruk Wildspeaker, resembling the ogres.

events.summary: The Onakke civilization is annihilated in a night by a dark spell cast by an unknown source.
events.quote: The massacre took only a night.

events.summary: Kothophed sends Liliana Vess to retrieve the Chain Veil; she meets the vengeful spirit of Kurkesh.
events.quote: the demon Kothophed sent Liliana Vess to retrieve the Chain Veil

events.summary: A group of dormant Onakke is reawakened by the Chain Veil's magic through Realmbreaker's Omenpaths.
events.quote: a group of dormant Onakke was reawakened by the Chain Veil's magic

relations.quote: the demon Kothophed sent Liliana Vess to retrieve the Chain Veil
